journey.name: forgotten PIN during wallet reset recovery
journey.description: Android-specific restricted recovery route. Use a prepared disposable, unfunded wallet with a known PIN and an unreadable reset marker; preparation requires a controlled storage fixture. Do not reset the wallet or enter its correct PIN in this journey. No seed display is needed. iOS profile-removal recovery is separate from this Android wallet-reset route.

actions.action: Open the app and verify the unreadable recovery overview, with no ordinary wallet controls
Verify Retry remains available beside Show Seed Phrase, tap Retry while the marker is still unreadable, and verify the overview remains without opening the PIN prompt or starting a reset
Tap Show Seed Phrase and verify the PIN prompt appears without displaying any seed
Enter one incorrect PIN and verify the prompt remains with an attempts-remaining link
Tap the attempts-remaining link and verify the recovery overview appears without a Forgot PIN sheet or reset confirmation
Tap Show Seed Phrase again and verify a fresh PIN prompt appears
Go back without entering a PIN, restart the app, and verify recovery remains pending without a queued Forgot PIN sheet
